build.buildCommand: npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run predeploy --skip-env-check && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production NODE_ENV=production node scripts/ensure-db-ready.mjs && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production NODE_ENV=production node --enable-source-maps artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs
